purpose: A schematic of the rule and of the quantities it leaves open, for the paper on the two works. Text and arrows only, plus one tile of work 1 cut from an existing image; it shows no value that has not been shown before.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-28 and committed before any script for it exists and before anything is drawn. Seen before: everything of results/work1, results/work1_drawing, results/work2_words, results/sketch_sp_color and the conditions they were made on. Version 2 (2026-10-28, still before any script or drawing), after the cross review of the task (.steering/20261028-while-blind-judgement): eps acts on the images of work 2 and only on the supplementary image of work 1 (version 1 had it the other way); the placeholders begin with FILL so that load_conditions catches them; the values of work 2 are read from works/conditions/work2_sp_color.json instead of being chosen after the scoring; a row for the scale of V and A (map B or percentiles); every value is either a path to a key of a conditions file or a literal checked against one.

layout.colour: black, white and greys only (the figure must read in print without colour)
layout.direction: left to right, one row of boxes joined by arrows

boxes.text: a unit of text (a sentence in work 1, a word in work 2)
valence V and arousal A from a lexicon, put on a scale
the rule: V and A give fineness f, depth s and sharpness gamma
the field of the generator (a seed, four octaves)
the relief: height under a scale
the image of the relief (how it is drawn)

open_quantities.how: labels in a second row under the box they act on, written as 'name: work 1 value / work 2 value'; each value is given either as a path {file, key} read at drawing time or as a literal; a literal is checked against the key named in its 'check' (else the run stops); a dash means the quantity does not act on the main images of that work
open_quantities.work2_main: the main images of work 2 are those of works/conditions/work2_sp_color.json (its versions SP and SPC); the scoring of the blind judgement decides only which of the grey and the coloured images is shown as the main one, by a rule written in the conditions of the paper's figures before the scoring is read. Until then work2.image_shown is FILL

work2.literal: author-equal percentiles among the words of the works, 2p - 1
one per word from its spelling

work1.literal: common to the series (per-tile min-max shown next to it)

work1.note: work 1 uses eps only in the supplementary image common_eps.png

work1.literal: grey; light from two directions; stretched

work2.literal: FILL: grey or grey with colour, by the rule of work2_main

tile.what: the tile of the first sentence of work 1 under the common scale, cut from results/work1/common.png at its place in the layout of work 1 (no resampling), shown under the box 'image'
tile.check: the cut equals the tile drawn afresh by works/work1.py for sentence 1 byte for byte (else the run stops)

outputs: results/rule_schematic/rule_schematic.png and rule_schematic.json (provenance: the conditions read and their SHA-256, every value read and every literal checked)
not_claimed: A schematic of the steps; it makes no claim about the effect of any quantity.
